subject: Pilot extension request — Clearline integration delay
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@clearline.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: pilot window & sandbox credits extension (integration blockers)

Hi Tessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the inbound support last week. We're still blocked on two pieces of the integration work that were supposed to land this sprint:

- Our SAML metadata is failing validation against your IdP (throws 400 on Handshake).
- The webhook delivery retries are causing backpressure on our staging ingest (we're seeing duplicated events when retries kick in).

Both are with our infra team right now but given the scope and an upcoming holiday week for one of our engineers, we expect about a 3-week delay to get a clean end-to-end demo.

We're hopeful Redwood can accommodate a short extension to keep the pilot alive while we finish the fixes — specifically: a 30-day extension to the pilot window and an extra 25k sandbox credits to handle the replays and additional testing.

Attached: integration_logs.zip (2.3MB), poc_scope.pdf (outline of remaining tasks).

Let us know what you can do, and if you want our SRE to jump on a call with your engineering folks to speed triage.

Appreciate it,

Amit Shah
Head of Integrations
Clearline.ai
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@clearline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pilot window & sandbox credits extension (integration blockers)

Hi Amit —

Thanks for the clear summary and for sending the logs. I'm sorry to hear you're hitting those infra headaches. We can help.

Proposed immediate steps:
1) We'll grant a 2-week extension today so you don't lose momentum while engineering triages.
2) Marissa (CC) and I will set up a joint triage call with your SREs tomorrow to go through the SAML metadata and webhook behavior.
3) We can temporarily add 15k sandbox credits right away; I need a quick confirmation from Revenue (CC Ben) for anything beyond that.

If you can confirm the names and availability of the SREs for the triage call (and a couple of example request IDs), we'll lock in a time.

I want to be upfront: I can approve the 2-week extension and 15k credits from my mailbox; for a 30-day extension and 25k credits we'll need a short internal sign-off (Ben is looped). I expect that sign-off to be straightforward given the issues are clearly engineering-driven.

Would you be able to join a 30-min triage at 11am PDT tomorrow?

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

On Thu, Oct 8, 2026 at 9:14 AM Amit Shah <amit@clearline.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the inbound support last week...

Tessa / Marissa — quick context from engineering side:
- SAML failure: our metadata generator is sending an unexpected x509 cert block; testing with a corrected metadata file resolves the handshake in local env. We need a config change in staging to accept the corrected metadata and re-run the provisioning flow.
- Webhook retries: the current retry policy in our consumer is aggressive; we'll implement idempotency keys to avoid duplication, but we need to replay ~18k events to validate before demo.

We've penciled a conservative timeline: config fix + provisioning test in 3 business days, idempotency rollout and event replay in 10 business days after that (assuming no regressions).

For the triage call, our SREs: Jamal Reed (jamal@clearline.ai) and Priya Menon (priya@clearline.ai). They can join 11am PDT on Oct 11.

Attached: stack_trace.txt (snippet showing the provisioning error).

Question: would Redwood be able to temporarily increase our sandbox concurrency by 2x during the replay window? That would help us finish the validation within the 10-day plan.

Thanks,
Claire
Director, Platform Engineering
Clearline.ai
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@clearline.ai>, Claire Donovan <claire@clearline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: pilot window & sandbox credits extension (integration blockers)

Hi Amit / Claire —

Thanks for the extra detail and for booking Jamal and Priya for the triage. We ran the call with Marissa and engineering this morning and confirmed the provisioning config change will unstick the SAML flow.

Final decision from our side:
- We will extend the pilot by 30 days (new end date: 2026-11-07).
- We are provisioning an additional 25,000 sandbox credits to your account to cover the replays and validation.
- We will grant a temporary 2x sandbox concurrency increase for a 10-day window tied to your replay run.

Next steps:
1) I attached an updated mutual action plan and a short amendment to the pilot MPA in HubSpot. Please review here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/companies/CL-147
2) I'll route the 25k credit approval through our revenue team; Ben, please confirm how you'd like the credit memo logged (PO vs email approval).
3) Claire / Jamal — once you confirm the replay window dates, we'll schedule the concurrency bump and monitor the runs.

Amit — if this matches what you were hoping for, reply-all with a short confirmation and I'll finalize the amendments and the credit memos.

Thanks — glad we could keep the pilot on track.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
